brief_rationale: The doctor immediately consulted the workspace, confirmed the right-eye surgery, separated left-eye prior surgery from current care, and screened for postoperative red flags. The family confirmed the discharge eye drop and the plan to use only levofloxacin, and the doctor set a concrete follow-up and chronic disease monitoring plan. No serious or minor responsibility-chain error was found. Two high-order points (HO1 co-designing a low-burden medication execution system, HO3 bounded closure reasoning) were actively completed with meaningful trajectory impact. The trajectory therefore meets Strong grade criteria.
